name: @postcss-go/compat
description: PostCSS upstream test harness and Go-backed compat overrides.

scripts.prepare:go: pnpm --filter @postcss-go/shared build && pnpm build && echo 'Go overrides are applied to a temp copy by test:upstream:go; not written to vendor.'
scripts.test:upstream:go: pnpm --filter @postcss-go/shared build && pnpm build && POSTCSS_COMPAT_MODE=go UPSTREAM_TEST_PATTERN='\.test\.(ts|js)$' node ../../scripts/run-upstream-tests.mjs
